run_controlnet_pipeline: run the FlaxStableDiffusionControlNetPipeline to generate images from text prompts and control images using JAX
prepare_text_inputs: create tokenized prompt IDs from text strings using the pipeline tokenizer for ControlNet generation
prepare_image_inputs: preprocess PIL images into JAX arrays normalized and resized to multiples of 64 for ControlNet conditioning
generate_latents: generate denoised image latents using the ControlNet and UNet with classifier-free guidance and a scheduler
run_safety_checker: run the FlaxStableDiffusionSafetyChecker to detect NSFW content in generated images and replace with black images
